author: norcalrowland
quote:
There seems to be a lot of cope and crying going on in the user reviews of this game in an attempt to justify the 13 year wait, and $70-$100 spent. More if you spent money on the garbage PS5 just for this game.

There's even weirdos review bombing other games (Like Zelda, Oot, which for weeks had a much higher user review score, and still is yet to drop below a 9 despite thousands of zero ratings being dropped in a day or two (not a coincidence) after this games user reviews utterly tanked (GTA 6 is 5.4 and dropping ).

*Spoiler free review of GTA 6*

Played it, seen it, enjoyed it a little even.

It's a improvement in a lot of ways to GTA V, but it's not a complete improvement. That being said after 13 years, hundreds of millions of dollars spent, the only people who are giving it perfect scores are the money gobbling reviewers gargling the coins they get for shilling out.

 Beyond that it's brain dead fans giving it a 10 with hardly any reasoning "best game I ever played!!" Or the other side of the fan coin being "worst game ever, you're a cuck and have to do chores and be nice to a girl".

There's infighting in its own community, it's not just random people review bombing this game exclusively, there are thousands that just find this game bad. That's okay, but I would say it's far from bad. The game isn't perfect. There are flat story beats, a mid story lul, lack of branching paths to handle certain missions, lots of actually on rail missions where nothing matters other than the interactive cutscenes playing out. If you don't press some on screen button prompts in a QTE, it'll do it for it, wolverine the game style. Truly a game of all time.

The gameplay is tighter, the driving is better, the gunplay has more impact and weight, and the details and realism are better than ever. However this game fails to deliver the full package. Forever locked at 30 fps, (something the world hung, waterboarded, flogged, burned and killed Cyberpunk for btw) is pathetic. It regularly chugs around 18-24 fps, that alone stops this game from being anywhere near a 10. No online after nearly 15 years , which will 100% cost money to activate, and potentially may even have a monthly fee as a part of the plan to profitmaxx this game. Maybe even some live service coming your way.

The weakest part of GTA 6 has to be Jason for me. Arthur Morgan lite really irked me throughout the game. It's his inability to become a fleshed out, memorable, charming, or even funny character that stand out the most. He gets completely outshined as a character by Lucia, who is written and voice acted way better than Jason. Side characters often completely outshine Jason as well. He looks and sounds too much like Arthur, as if it was by intention. But it comes across strange and like he's a simple and stiff dude just phoning it in.

No one can ever convince me that Franklin, Trevor, and Micheal aren't infinitely more entertaining and better characters than Jason and even Lucia. It's a step backwards in that respect, big time. Niko of GTA 4 makes these two characters look like goofy saints row avatars by comparison. Arthur Morgan himself? This game has been toated as a spiritual sequel to RDR2 Because of how it's made, but sadly it really can never compare. Arthur, his story, his portrayal, makes the best character moments in GTA 6 seem average to poor at best. 

This game isn't a 10/10.
